review.explanation: The surface form 桓景真 is being resolved to 趙至, but the evidence clearly identifies 桓景真 as the courtesy name (字) of 桓亮, not 趙至. The annotation sfh1-ev-19-xianyuan-032-liu-annotation-003 explicitly states '續晉陽秋曰桓亮字景真', establishing that 景真 is the courtesy name of 桓亮. The main text mentions '桓景真之難' referring to the disaster caused by 桓亮 (桓景真). There is no evidence connecting 桓景真 to 趙至 whatsoever. The retrieval basis 'profile:catalogue_exact_match' appears to be a spurious match — 趙至's courtesy name is 景真 (趙景真), but the surface here is 桓景真, which is a different person (桓亮). The surname 桓 is decisive: this is 桓亮, not 趙至. The proposed resolution to 趙至 is a false identity conflation based on shared courtesy name 景真 without accounting for the distinguishing surname 桓.

韓康伯 is the courtesy name of 韓伯. The main text identifies him as the father of 繪之 and husband of 殷氏. The resolution to 韓伯 is well-supported by the evidence.

There is absolutely no evidence connecting 桓亮 to 趙至. The retrieval basis 'profile:evidence_identity_assertion' appears to be a spurious conflation — likely confusing 桓亮's courtesy name 景真 with 趙至's courtesy name 景真. But 桓亮 and 趙至 are entirely different historical figures. This resolution must be rejected.

康伯 is the courtesy name of 韓伯. The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-19-xianyuan-032-liu-annotation-001) states '倫父康伯太常卿', identifying 康伯 as 韓伯 who held the office of 太常卿. The alias registry confirms 康伯 as a courtesy name for 韓伯. The coreference with 韓康伯 (sfh1-mention-2675431ffe4b34d74ef858bf) is consistent. Resolution to 韓伯 is well-supported.

The surface 桓亮 is being resolved to 趙至, but the evidence clearly identifies 桓亮 as a distinct historical person — the grandson of 大司馬温 and son of 濟, with courtesy name 景真. The annotation sfh1-ev-19-xianyuan-032-liu-annotation-003 states '續晉陽秋曰桓亮字景真' and sfh1-ev-19-xianyuan-032-liu-annotation-004 describes his rebellion. There is absolutely no evidence connecting 桓亮 to 趙至. The retrieval basis 'profile:evidence_identity_assertion' appears to be a spurious conflation — likely confusing 桓亮's courtesy name 景真 with 趙至's courtesy name 景真. But 桓亮 and 趙至 are entirely different historical figures. This resolution must be rejected.
